question: When are applications due for the transit capital call?
expected: Capital applications are due in COTRAMS by 11:59 p.m. MT on December 11, 2026 (the window opened October 12, 2026), and late applications are not accepted. Agencies new to DTR funding must submit the New Applicant Questionnaire by 11:59 p.m. MT on November 13, 2026.

question: Is there a cap on how much we can request for a bus facility project?
expected: Yes. Other capital project requests (facilities, equipment, studies, support vehicles) are capped at $1,000,000. The minimum request is $25,000 (except when state funds are used as local match for federal funds), and every program requires a 20% local match.
